title: internal/cli TestRunEpicFailsClosed fails in a linked worktree: gate config path is cwd-relative, not repo-rooted
body: Running `go test ./internal/cli` from this worktree, `ticfac run-epic` resolves its gate configuration to `<worktree>/internal/cli/.tick/runners.toml` (the package's cwd) instead of the repository root, so `TestRunEpicFailsClosed` gets exit 1 'read the gate configuration: no such file or directory' instead of the acceptance exit 2 'no executor configured'. Reproduced byte-identically at the base commit 488591ac, so it is pre-existing; every ticfac run dispatches workers from linked worktrees, so any test or code path with the same cwd-relative resolution will misbehave there too.
